scope.useCase: Default selected 1962 Calendar day, source-identified principal Mass, source and day commemorations, individual oration source rows; four existing form-specific commemoration projections inspected on relevant days.

evidence.extendedChecks: On every selected 2024–2029 Mass's Secret and Postcommunion, look for explicit plural Latin N. et N., French one N., and Martyr category after accent normalization.

interpretation.finding: No explicit exact C6b or C7b identity in the default selected Calendar principal, its source or day commemorations or an individual oration row across 2024–2029. The selected Secret/Postcommunion row bodies also yielded zero cases with Latin plural N. et N. but one French N. in a Martyrs prayer.
interpretation.releaseImpact: The deployed source-attested French Common fix is defensive for direct/Common source access. This six-year scan establishes no observed direct default Calendar exposure; do not claim the correction affected a selected Calendar day. Text-level inherited donor mismatch candidates: zero for the exact two-name Latin placeholder / one-name French signature.
interpretation.namedSaint: Perpetua/Felicity are owned by Sancti/03-06, not the direct Commune/C7b path. Their separately deployed PR #1788 remains valid.
untested: Indirect nested @Commune or vide C6b/C7b donor inheritance within a named Proper: the scan does not recursively expand internal source references.
Explicit user-selected votive, Requiem, nuptial, or observed-source alternate Mass; the default Calendar resolver does not select these without user choice.
Local or private calendar observances not represented in the production default resolver.
Dates after 2029 or changes to the source library after this audited head.

reading: Zero exact matches is an observed bound on the default selected Calendar path, not a claim that these Commons are inaccessible in every app mode.
